events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Mathieu Olivier scored twice in the third period, and Elvis Merzlikins made 23 saves for his first shutout of the season as the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Tuesday night for their sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olivier scores twice and Merzlikins has 1st shutout of season as Blue Jackets beat Devils 3-0

headlines.description: — Jamie Drysdale scored on the power play to snap a 20-game streak without a goal, Dan Vladar made 26 saves, and the Philadelphia Flyers ended a four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Capitals 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers snap losing streak with 4-2 win over Capitals

headlines.description: — Jordan Staal scored the go-ahead goal with roughly five minutes left to help the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Ottawa Senators 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Staal's goal pushes Hurricanes past Senators 4-3 in final home game before Olympic break

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Jake Guentzel scored with 14 seconds remaining in overtime after teammate Darren Raddysh forced the extra session by scoring with 26 seconds left in regulation as the Tampa Bay Lightning beat Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guentzel's goal in the final seconds of OT gives the Lightning a 4-3 win over the Sabres

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat scored his second goal of the game 52 seconds into overtime and the New York Islanders beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Horvat's 2nd goal of the game lifts the Islanders over the Penguins 5-4 in overtime

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Matias Maccelli scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs defeated the Edmonton Oilers 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maccelli scores 2 as Maple Leafs beat Oilers 5-2, head into Olympic break with 3 straight wins

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored his 25th goal and the Anaheim Ducks defeated the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Tuesday night to win their final game before the Olympic break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gauthier gets 25th goal and surging Ducks beat Kraken 4-2 to move closer to Pacific Division lead
